entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of variant 'strange object' of item 'strange object'
identity:
It seems to be a heavy chunk of light pink amber.  Suspended inside the amber are… fossils?  You're unsure what to call them.

One appears to be a small ball of hair with copper wires reaching out in one direction, reminiscent of an amoeba reaching for something.  Another appears to be a tiny fern, only made out of a highly iridescent metal, with blades quite literally as thin as a razor.  A third, particularly horrifying one appears to be the shrunken head of a human with a network of dark red nerves instead of hair.
